title: Family on Bridge, 1920s Sepia Snapshot, Ed & Goldie Hazelwood
back_text_transcription: 457 Ed & Goldie Hazelwood & her daughter Louise
description: A late 1920s sepia snapshot depicting a family standing on the wooden deck of a metal truss bridge surrounded by lush trees. Identified on the reverse as Ed, Goldie Hazelwood, and her daughter Louise, the group poses together against the bridge railing. Goldie wears a fashionable 1920s cloche hat and patterned dress, reflecting the casual fashion of the Jazz Age era.
